name: xhs-video-download
doc: resolve one xhs note's play address (video notes) via the web feed endpoint. Evidence: MediaCrawler creator-mode feed param table (knowledge-only, IR-MM-0001 D-2) cross-checked against f2 apps/xhs request shape (Apache-2.0, ADR-0101). x-s / x-s-common ride HTTP request headers (IFACE-7) and are computed by the deployment-owned signsvc script (HARDENING M3 — the algorithm never ships in this repo); the CDN stream GET itself is unsigned. Image notes carry no video stream: play_url binds empty and resolve fails closed with an explicit error — use the user-posts listing's extra.images with the download_media atom instead.

cookie.source: browser profile import or env MEDIAMON_XHS_COOKIES
